title: Configuration bound
statement:
For a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet, with $N.k$ work tapes, and natural numbers $n$ and $s$, define its configuration bound by
\[3\bigl(|Q|+1\bigr)(n+2)\,3^{N.k(2s+1)}(2s+1)^{N.k},\]
where $|Q|$ is the number of states of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
